title: The Rainy season on the coast
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：rainy　|　正文 333 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 rainy 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 the grower wrote of ① a rainy season on the coast in the ledger, and everybody in the greenhouse said at once that it was ② rainier than the one named there the year before. Three summers on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the grower, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the rainy ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the rainiest season on the coast anybody in the greenhouse had ever seen, or so the ledger for August 1963 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too rainy to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the buyer who had come to help; the rainy ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the crate at the far shelf, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a rainy afternoon in April, and said that no buyer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as rainy as the afternoon in April they had once had in the old greenhouse. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was rainy or not, and he said so.

By 1976 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something rainy, and nothing besides. The buyer from the next greenhouse called the whole plan ⑧ quite rainy; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the rainy ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1979, in silence, she wrote of another rainy season on the coast in the same ledger, and the work, which took two summers, seemed ⑨ rainier than anybody had expected. ⑩ The rainiest afternoon in April in the whole greenhouse, she said in 1981, was the one she could never quite name; the rainy ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 多雨（前置定语 a rainy season on the coast：1969 年种植户在收成账里记下的那件多雨的季节）
B. adj. 多雨／阴雨（比较级 rainier than：文中两处，一处比海滨的多雨季节，一处比预想）
C. adj. 多雨／阴雨（最高级 the rainiest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 多雨（表语 too rainy to do：母亲觉得它太多雨，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 阴雨（前置定语 a rainy afternoon in April：叔叔把整件事称作一桩阴雨的午后）
F. adj. 阴雨（同级比较 as rainy as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩四月里阴雨的午后相比）
G. adj. 阴雨（后置定语 something rainy：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 阴雨（受程度副词修饰 quite rainy：那位收购人的评价）

items.q: a rainy season on the coast
the rainiest season on the coast anybody
The rainiest afternoon in April in

answers.why: rainy 意为“多雨”，1969 年种植户在收成账里记下的是“一件多雨的季节”，此处作前置定语 a rainy season on the coast。
rainy 意为“多雨”，此处用比较级 rainier than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
rainy 意为“多雨”，收成账上 八月 那行字说它是大棚里最多雨的一件，故用最高级 the rainiest season on the coast。
rainy 意为“多雨”，母亲认为这件东西“太多雨了，谁也用不上”，too rainy to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
rainy 意为“阴雨”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩阴雨的午后”，此处作前置定语 a rainy afternoon in April。
rainy 意为“阴雨”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩四月里阴雨的午后一样阴雨”，同级比较用 as rainy as。
rainy 意为“阴雨”，收成账上那半行字要的是“阴雨的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something rainy。
rainy 意为“阴雨”，邻大棚来的那位收购人认为这套计划“相当阴雨”，quite 修饰原级 rainy。
rainy 意为“阴雨”，1979 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要阴雨”，故用比较级 rainier than。
rainy 意为“阴雨”，母亲 1981 年说的是“整个大棚里最阴雨的那一桩”，故用最高级 the rainiest afternoon in April。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1969 年，种植户在收成账里记下了一件多雨的季节。（a rainy season on the coast）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更多雨。（rainier than …）
母亲觉得它太多雨，谁也用不上。（too rainy to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩阴雨的午后。（a rainy afternoon in April）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩四月里阴雨的午后一样阴雨。（as rainy as …）
到了 1976 年，收成账上只剩半行字：要的是一件阴雨的东西。（something rainy）
answers: In 1969 the grower wrote of a rainy season on the coast in the ledger.
Everybody said it was rainier than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too rainy to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a rainy afternoon in April.
He said nobody would call it as rainy as the afternoon in April they had once had.
By 1976 the ledger asked for nothing but something rainy.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 rainy 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1969 the grower wrote of a rainy season on the coast in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the rainiest season on the coast in the greenhouse, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too rainy to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a rainy afternoon in April, and nobody argued with him.
The buyer from the next greenhouse called the plan quite rainy, and everybody laughed.
The rainy ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
